title: fw-wan firewall & VPN logs
description: fw-wan's syslog in Loki: the firewall log parsed (chain, rule, action, interfaces, addresses, ports), top dropped sources/destinations/ports/rules, strongSwan IKE events and the rest of the router log.

list.name: addr
list.label: Address
list.description: Only firewall lines containing this text (an address, port, interface).

list.name: search
list.label: Search (regex)
list.description: Case-insensitive RE2 regex on the line; empty matches everything.

panels.title: Logged packets
panels.description: Firewall rules with `log` enabled, in the time range (action and address pickers apply).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |= `$addr` | regexp `^\s*\[(?P<family>ipv[46])-(?P<hook>[A-Z]+)-(?P<chain>.+)-(?P<rule>[^-\]]+)-(?P<act>[ADR])\]\s*IN=(?P<in>\S*) OUT=(?P<out>\S*)` | logfmt SRC, DST, PROTO, SPT, DPT | label_format src=SRC, dst=DST, proto=PROTO, spt=SPT, dpt=DPT | label_format action=`{{ if eq .act "A" }}accept{{ else if eq .act "D" }}drop{{ else }}reject{{ end }}` | drop act, __error__, __error_details__ | action=~"${action:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Dropped
panels.description: Logged drops (address picker applies).

panels.title: Distinct sources
panels.description: Source addresses in the logged packets.

targets.expr: count(sum by (src) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |= `$addr` | regexp `^\s*\[(?P<family>ipv[46])-(?P<hook>[A-Z]+)-(?P<chain>.+)-(?P<rule>[^-\]]+)-(?P<act>[ADR])\]\s*IN=(?P<in>\S*) OUT=(?P<out>\S*)` | logfmt SRC, DST, PROTO, SPT, DPT | label_format src=SRC, dst=DST, proto=PROTO, spt=SPT, dpt=DPT | label_format action=`{{ if eq .act "A" }}accept{{ else if eq .act "D" }}drop{{ else }}reject{{ end }}` | drop act, __error__, __error_details__ | action=~"${action:regex}" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Logged packets by rule
panels.description: Per chain and rule; the action is the rule's (accept/drop/reject).

targets.expr: sum by (chain, rule, action) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |= `$addr` | regexp `^\s*\[(?P<family>ipv[46])-(?P<hook>[A-Z]+)-(?P<chain>.+)-(?P<rule>[^-\]]+)-(?P<act>[ADR])\]\s*IN=(?P<in>\S*) OUT=(?P<out>\S*)` | logfmt SRC, DST, PROTO, SPT, DPT | label_format src=SRC, dst=DST, proto=PROTO, spt=SPT, dpt=DPT | label_format action=`{{ if eq .act "A" }}accept{{ else if eq .act "D" }}drop{{ else }}reject{{ end }}` | drop act, __error__, __error_details__ | action=~"${action:regex}" [$__auto]))

sum by (action) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |= `$addr` | regexp `^\s*\[(?P<family>ipv[46])-(?P<hook>[A-Z]+)-(?P<chain>.+)-(?P<rule>[^-\]]+)-(?P<act>[ADR])\]\s*IN=(?P<in>\S*) OUT=(?P<out>\S*)` | logfmt SRC, DST, PROTO, SPT, DPT | label_format src=SRC, dst=DST, proto=PROTO, spt=SPT, dpt=DPT | label_format action=`{{ if eq .act "A" }}accept{{ else if eq .act "D" }}drop{{ else }}reject{{ end }}` | drop act, __error__, __error_details__ | action=~"${action:regex}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: By inbound interface
panels.description: IN= of the logged packet (a VRF device for routed traffic).

targets.expr: sum by (in) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |= `$addr` | regexp `^\s*\[(?P<family>ipv[46])-(?P<hook>[A-Z]+)-(?P<chain>.+)-(?P<rule>[^-\]]+)-(?P<act>[ADR])\]\s*IN=(?P<in>\S*) OUT=(?P<out>\S*)` | logfmt SRC, DST, PROTO, SPT, DPT | label_format src=SRC, dst=DST, proto=PROTO, spt=SPT, dpt=DPT | label_format action=`{{ if eq .act "A" }}accept{{ else if eq .act "D" }}drop{{ else }}reject{{ end }}` | drop act, __error__, __error_details__ | action=~"${action:regex}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Top sources (dropped/rejected)
panels.description: Logged drops and rejects in the time range (the action picker doesn't apply).

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (src) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |= `$addr` | regexp `^\s*\[(?P<family>ipv[46])-(?P<hook>[A-Z]+)-(?P<chain>.+)-(?P<rule>[^-\]]+)-(?P<act>[ADR])\]\s*IN=(?P<in>\S*) OUT=(?P<out>\S*)` | logfmt SRC, DST, PROTO, SPT, DPT | label_format src=SRC, dst=DST, proto=PROTO, spt=SPT, dpt=DPT | label_format action=`{{ if eq .act "A" }}accept{{ else if eq .act "D" }}drop{{ else }}reject{{ end }}` | drop act, __error__, __error_details__ | action=~"drop|reject" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Firewall log
panels.description: The newest 500 logged packets. The Message column has the full line.

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |= `$addr` | regexp `^\s*\[(?P<family>ipv[46])-(?P<hook>[A-Z]+)-(?P<chain>.+)-(?P<rule>[^-\]]+)-(?P<act>[ADR])\]\s*IN=(?P<in>\S*) OUT=(?P<out>\S*)` | logfmt SRC, DST, PROTO, SPT, DPT | label_format src=SRC, dst=DST, proto=PROTO, spt=SPT, dpt=DPT | label_format action=`{{ if eq .act "A" }}accept{{ else if eq .act "D" }}drop{{ else }}reject{{ end }}` | drop act, __error__, __error_details__ | action=~"${action:regex}"

panels.title: IKE initiating
panels.description: charon lines matching `initiating (IKE|CHILD)_SA|establishing CHILD_SA` in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `initiating (IKE|CHILD)_SA|establishing CHILD_SA` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: IKE established
panels.description: charon lines matching `(IKE|CHILD)_SA \S+ established` in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `(IKE|CHILD)_SA \S+ established` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: IKE retransmits
panels.description: charon lines matching `retransmit \d+ of` in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `retransmit \d+ of` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: IKE failures
panels.description: charon lines matching `(?i:giving up|failed|no proposal chosen|authentication_failed|peer not responding|timed out|unable to|no IKE config)` in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `(?i:giving up|failed|no proposal chosen|authentication_failed|peer not responding|timed out|unable to|no IKE config)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: IKE deleted
panels.description: charon lines matching `deleting (IKE|CHILD)_SA|closing CHILD_SA|IKE_SA \S+ (deleted|rekeyed)` in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `deleting (IKE|CHILD)_SA|closing CHILD_SA|IKE_SA \S+ (deleted|rekeyed)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Lines (range)
panels.description: All charon lines, packet traces included.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `initiating (IKE|CHILD)_SA|establishing CHILD_SA` [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `(IKE|CHILD)_SA \S+ established` [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `retransmit \d+ of` [$__auto]))

sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `(?i:giving up|failed|no proposal chosen|authentication_failed|peer not responding|timed out|unable to|no IKE config)` [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `deleting (IKE|CHILD)_SA|closing CHILD_SA|IKE_SA \S+ (deleted|rekeyed)` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Initiations by connection
panels.description: A connection that keeps initiating without 'established' is stuck CONNECTING (a peer that doesn't answer, like VPS-lylat-space).

targets.expr: sum by (sa) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} |~ `initiating IKE_SA|establishing CHILD_SA` | regexp `(?:IKE|CHILD)_SA (?P<sa>[A-Za-z0-9][\w.-]*)[\[{]` [$__auto]))

panels.title: strongSwan (without packet traces)
panels.description: charon's log minus 'sending/received packet' and message parse/generate lines.

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"charon.*"} !~ `sending packet|received packet|parsed \S+ (request|response)|generating \S+ (request|response)`

panels.title: WireGuard
panels.description: The kernel's WireGuard module only logs with dynamic debug, so this is usually empty; handshakes and traffic are on the fw-wan VPNs dashboard (metrics).

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host="fw-wan"} |~ `(?i)wireguard|\bwg[0-9]+\b`

panels.title: Config commits
panels.description: VyOS 'Successful change to active configuration'.

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app="commit"}

panels.title: Everything else
panels.description: fw-wan's log without firewall, strongSwan and commit lines (search picker applies).

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app!~"charon.*|commit"} !~ `^\s*\[ipv[46]-` |~ `(?i)$search`
